camera help

allow camera access in this site’s browser settings. also check your device’s camera permissions. if you opened this page inside another app, open it directly in safari or chrome.

close other apps using your camera, then tap enable camera again.

move your hand to aim. point your index finger and curl the other three fingers into your palm to draw; open your hand to move. hover over a canvas button for 1.2 seconds to switch to eraser, undo, or pause.

questions

is my camera video uploaded?

no. hand tracking processes frames on your device. opencanvas does not upload or record your camera video.

where is my drawing saved?

your last drawing is saved in this browser on this device when storage is available. each visit starts blank; choose “restore last drawing” to reopen it. use “save image” to download a png you can keep. clearing browser data removes the saved copy.

can i draw without a camera?

yes. choose “mouse or touch” and drag on the canvas. camera access is only requested when you press “enable camera.”

why isn’t my camera starting?

allow camera access in your browser’s website settings and your device’s permissions. close other camera apps and open opencanvas directly in safari or chrome. the message below “enable camera” shows which setup step needs attention.

how do i make the brush more stable?

raise stability, keep your hand in good light, and choose a smaller movement range if that feels easier. use “center on my hand” to reset the cursor position.

camera frames stay on your device.

how to draw

mouse or touch: drag across the canvas.

camera: choose hand movements, then enable camera. point your index finger and curl the other three fingers into your palm to draw. open your hand to move without drawing.

hover over the buttons below the canvas for 1.2 seconds to switch brush/eraser, undo, or pause. pinch and ink-button controls are also available.

bucket: tap inside a closed shape. airbrush: drag for soft shading; repeat passes to darken it. lasso: outline a shape and release to fill it with your selected color. each tool also uses your chosen drawing gesture in camera mode.

press h in hand mode to show the hand skeleton and tracking speed. adjust brush size and stability on the left. save image downloads a png.

about opencanvas

opencanvas is an early exploration of adaptable creative tools. its accessibility benefits have not yet been validated with users. hand tracking may work differently with different movements, lighting, and devices.

your privacy

the camera starts only when you enable it. frames are processed locally, not uploaded or recorded. your drawing is saved in this browser’s local storage. each visit starts blank; restore last drawing brings back your saved work. clearing browser data removes it. download your artwork to keep a copy.

hand tracking uses google mediapipe. camera mode requires a supported browser and camera permission. mouse and touch work without a camera.

erase the whole canvas?

you can undo this, or save your current drawing as an image first.
